transcript: alright listen up, you have the rare opportunity to see an unhinged cult comedy musical from the same composer as Heathers and legally blonde with one of its original stars returning to a new role last night I attended the invited dress rehearsal of Bat Boy at Encores a musical with a campy sense of humor but actually dares to go to some dark, twisted places that you don't usually see in musical theatre the production also features a pretty stellar cast Taylor Trensch is excellent in the title role it's great to see Kerry Butler return to the show as Meredith after originating the role of Shelly and meanwhile Gabi Carruba is a big standout as Shelly in this production Alex Newell also makes a cameo in Act 2 in one of the show's most bizarre, out-there numbers the show also holds a special place in my heart I was actually in it in college and that also gave me a deep appreciation for how surprisingly well crafted this is it strikes an impressive balance between kooky comedy and earnest tragedy and for how fun and catchy the songs are they're surprisingly intricate and how they're composed almost like a contemporary operetta I've been itching for an opportunity to see a live production of this musical ever since this is a long overdue return to New York so I'm delighted that Encores chose to do it I will say there are a pretty substantial number of changes for this production they've added several songs they've cut several songs and retooled the book in some other ways I will say maybe it's my nostalgia glasses but I thought the changes were a little bit hit or miss some of the added songs I liked more than others some of the cut songs I really missed but I do think this version is impressively streamlined it moves at a really good pace and I'm guessing that's part of the intention behind some of the cuts in either case I'm so glad I was able to catch this it's running at Encores now through November 9th and I would definitely not sleep on this
